label: TP
reason: The CodeQL alert correctly identifies a genuine XSS vulnerability. User-supplied input from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest00369") flows directly into the Cookie name via cookieName (line 72), which is then used unencoded in the HTML response string (line 91-96). The fact that the cookie value itself is encoded later (line 95) does not mitigate the XSS risk posed by the unencoded cookie name being written to the page.

evidence.note: User input flows into cookieName variable and is concatenated into response writer without HTML encoding, creating an XSS vector.
